prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create a single transparent PNG sprite atlas for a top-down oblique 2D pixel-art magic academy RPG, showing four INDIVIDUAL standing teenage wizard academy students, arrayed as four isolated full-length figures in one perfectly straight horizontal row. Reference image 1 is the art direction: emulate specifically the individual students from that courtyard concept (pixel cluster brushwork, muted warm tones, classic dark academy robes, heads slightly large, projecting faces with upper head and shoulders visible; front, profile and back silhouettes), but redraw four distinct original students. Draw with crisp intentional pixel clusters and clean dark outline at a rendered size of 24 pixels wide by 40 tall for each figure, enlarged into a big source canvas. Rich three-value material shades, dark warm charcoal outer line, localized bright pixels as cloth edge and hair highlights, late afternoon golden key from upper right and shadowy shaded sides. Their pixel density and proportions should match the reference's small characters, modest chibi head-to-body ratio and fully visible feet. Quiet standing poses with no active gestures.
Four equally spaced figures at x=12.5%,37.5%,62.5%,87.5%, same feet baseline, abundant clear padding between figures. At far left: boy with short warm brown hair wearing dark navy robe with warm gold trim and chest crest, facing away north, full back visible. Second: dark jade-haired girl wearing deep green short cloak and forest robe with gold edge, faces left in three-quarter profile. Third: chestnut-haired girl with tied-back hair, deep wine burgundy robe and tan satchel, facing toward viewer south with face clearly visible. Fourth: sandy haired boy with a long dark navy robe and subdued bronze detailing, facing right in three-quarter profile. Distinct silhouettes. No eyes bigger than a single pixel at game size. No tall hats, no wands, no halos, no base plate, no drop shadows, no reflections, no scenery, no lettering, no caption, no decorative marks. Actual alpha transparency all around and between four fully isolated figures. Each figure must be standalone ready for extraction.
